profile.headline: Software Engineer 1 @ Intuit || iOS & Android Dev
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer 1 at Intuit, specializing in mobile application development across Android and iOS.

I graduated from Georgia State University with a B.S. in Computer Science and have experience developing mobile applications using Kotlin, Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit. During my time as a Software Engineering Intern at Intuit, I contributed to building and improving mobile experiences, strengthening my passion for creating intuitive, user-focused applications.

Now, as a full-time Software Engineer at Intuit, I'm continuing to expand my expertise in Android development while leveraging my iOS background to build impactful mobile experiences.

I'm passionate about software engineering, mobile technology, and continuous learning, and I'm always excited to connect with fellow engineers and professionals in tech.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed a production-shipped iOS Request Provider feature using Swift, SwiftUI, and MVVM, implementing API integration, localized interfaces, and automated UI tests. 

Standardized provider selection interfaces across six screens using reusable UI components, consistent typography, and theme-aware styling. 

Implemented provider outage and maintenance messaging with conditional display logic and localized status indicators. 

Developed consent analytics event handlers, refactored existing UI components, and contributed to Android development using Kotlin.
positions.insights: Skills: SwiftUI · Mobile Applications · Jira · Agile Methodologies · Kotlin · UIKit · CocoaPods · Swift (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a project list interface using React, HTML, and CSS, allowing 50+ students across multiple majors to discover and collaborate on projects.

Integrated Google Authentication, improving security and reducing the need for manual account creation.
